post.caption: M&M's turned peanut butter into diamonds. For the 2024 Super Bowl, M&M's made an Almost Champions ring for stars who never won a Super Bowl ring. The 14 karat gold ring holds diamonds made from Peanut Butter M&M's, with a diamond covered replica of the Orange M&M's character on top. It opens into a mini football stadium holding one Peanut Butter M&M. The 30 second ad ran in the first quarter on CBS. About 3,000 degrees Celsius and 800,000 psi turned peanut butter into diamond.
